# Feature: World Atlas Editor (Leaflet + Geoman, dual navigation)

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-10-16 — do not edit manually unless correcting intent -->

## Intent

Replace the single 60×60 tile canvas as the only world map with a hierarchical Fantasy World Atlas: Leaflet (`CRS.Simple`) + Geoman Free for geometry editing, multiple maps per `worldProfileId`, shared by Library → Welten → Karte and Saga → Welt → Karte. Prefer Azgaar for procedural generation via native `.map` storage + import (not invented APIs). Preserve legacy `world_maps` tiles/pins/party via adapter. Surface: **Workstation** (editor) / **Journey** (viewer). Gates: **AU-CONTENT-WIDTH**, **AU-TOUCH**, **IV-*** for map as spatial aid (not full world simulation).

Tracking: GitHub #702.

## Preconditions

- Authenticated user; world profile readable (`current_user_can_read_world_profile`).
- Edit requires `current_user_can_edit_world_profile` (Library) or equivalent GM + world-edit grant in Saga context.
- Migrations through `094_world_atlas` applied.
- Existing Dornhain/`world_maps` rows still present for legacy adapter.

## Happy Path

- [ ] **Library:** `/library/worlds/:worldPublicId/map` opens full-workspace atlas for that world (`data-world-atlas-workbench`).
- [ ] **Saga:** `/sagas/:sagaPublicId/world/map` opens the same workbench bound to the saga’s `worldProfileId` (no duplicate map rows).
- [ ] Both entry points share one React composition (`WorldAtlasWorkbench`).
- [ ] User can create an empty root map or keep the migrated legacy tile root.
- [ ] User can draw/edit polygons (countries/regions) and markers (places) with Geoman Free; save survives reload (revision conflict → DE error).
- [ ] User can add a child detail map under a region/place and navigate via breadcrumb (explicit map switch, no magic zoom).
- [ ] Legacy tile editor remains reachable for the legacy root (`Kacheln`) so existing maps are not lost.
- [ ] Player / non-editor view hides secret/undiscovered features (server-side filter on load, not client-only CSS).
- [ ] Import Azgaar `.map` stores the native file in Storage and records `generator_meta`; user can download/reopen later without data loss of the blob.

## Edge Cases

- [ ] No `worldProfileId` on saga → DE empty state + link to Library Welten / bind world (no invented UUID).
- [ ] Concurrent save with stale revision → fail closed with DE message (no silent overwrite).
- [ ] Oversized basemap / `.map` upload → rejected (size/MIME limits).
- [ ] Phone: side panes become Sheets; primary map remains usable (`AU-*`).
- [ ] Invalid GeoJSON on save → domain validation rejects before RPC.

## Regression

- [ ] Existing Hub `Welt → Orte / Karten` atlas panel still loads map (can deep-link to `/world/map`).
- [ ] Live GM party position + pin discovery paths still work on legacy tile data.
- [ ] `npm run test-gate` / architecture-boundary-check / edge-cors green.
- [ ] World profile dialog no longer the only edit surface (link to full atlas screen).

## Assumptions

- Phase 1–3 ship first: schema + Leaflet/Geoman + dual nav + legacy adapter. Full Azgaar iframe self-host is Phase 4 (spike documents approach; `.map` storage ships earlier).
- Mapgen4 / SettleMaker deferred; do not block core.
- Public map IDs use UUID internally; deep links use `WO-` world public id + map UUID query/segment as needed.
- DaisyUI / Next.js rules in personal user_rules do **not** apply — SagaTree stack (Vite/React/Radix) wins per `AGENTS.md`.

## Security Coverage

- F-01 / B-01: RLS on atlas tables via existing world profile read/edit helpers; no client-elevated ownership.
- F-03 / B-04: Storage paths scoped to `auth.uid()` folder; no Base64 map blobs in JSONB.
- B-07/B-08: Saga map edit requires GM/world-edit; player view uses `player_view` RPC flag.
- SC-01 IDOR: world resolved by public id → server lookup; map id must belong to that world.
- SC-02: GeoJSON/layers validated server-side size caps.
- SC-03: Upload rate via existing storage + size limits.
- SC-06: No secrets in client.
- Launch Checklist (SC): N/A — not a launch ticket.
